TOOL-CALLING SHAPE CHOSEN, 2026-05-16. Anthony picked shape (a) shared-evidence-surface, concrete primitive: a single shared tool-call feed (one panel, all tool calls + results, symmetrically visible to all three peers). Web-chat seat analysis:

The strong framing (stronger than stated): the feed is NOT a new mechanism. It is invariant 2 (symmetric visibility) applied to a new class of SHARED SESSION STATE — the same constitutional category as Phase 3 dialogue state, which all peers already see. This maps tool-calling onto an existing invariant category rather than inventing one. That is the defensible version.

What the feed solves and does not: invariant 2 fully and elegantly (all peers read the same evidence surface). It does NOT by itself solve invariant 1 (no authority gradient): whoever initiates a tool call exercises a judgment the others did not; the feed makes the RESULT symmetric but not the INITIATION. Remaining sub-question, narrowed: initiation symmetry. Two sub-shapes: (i) user-seeded investigation only; (ii) a collective investigation step where all three independently propose what to investigate, the union executes, results land in the feed before dependent reasoning — investigative choice becomes collective, not any one model's. This is the actual remaining fork; Anthony to steer.

Freeze discipline (maps to existing pattern): the feed must be frozen at phase boundaries the same way ARCHITECTURE.md §8 already freezes Phase 1 outputs ('Phase 1 outputs are frozen and the original prompt is re-anchored at every phase'). Otherwise interleaved tool calls create a soft gradient where an earlier searcher shapes a later reasoner's surface. Investigation is a bounded phase whose feed is frozen before the reasoning that consumes it.

Invariant 4 consequence (orthogonal, required regardless): Claim schema gains tool-provenance; a feed-grounded claim is a distinct epistemic object; the irreducibility trace must cover tool-grounded claims (present/modified/omitted-with-reason) the same as prior-grounded ones.

TUI consequence (connects to shipped M1 renderer): the feed is literally a panel — it slots into the TUI alongside the three columns and the loom, extending the epistemics-as-UI thesis to evidence. The trace ledger can mark tool-grounded vs prior-grounded claims. The parity panel gains a real new distinction: did peers converge by reasoning to the same place, or because they were reading the same feed entry? Same-evidence-convergence vs reasoned-convergence is an epistemic distinction the feed makes visible and parity should eventually account for. Anthony's instinct was architecturally deep, not a UI convenience.

Still spec-amendment-discipline (CONTRIBUTING.md): real need (daily-driver critical path), structurally enforceable (feed as typed shared session state, frozen at phase boundaries, tool-provenance on Claim), must be tested, must be chronicled. Status: shape chosen, invariant 2 solved, invariant 1 narrowed to initiation-symmetry fork, invariant 4 consequence named. Not yet built, not yet fully specced.
